name: AI Visibility Assurance
target: A buyer can move from vague anxiety or curiosity about AI search to an evidence-backed decision about whether there is a material visibility problem, what layer causes it, and the least costly warranted next action.
boundary: private mock-client QA until Leader approval
no external solicitation or external payment during the QA phase
no guaranteed ranking, citation, recommendation, or revenue claims
no fabricated measurements from inaccessible answer surfaces
no mass-produced prompt-shaped content as a substitute for useful evidence
no default assumption that the customer needs the paid audit
no sale when the triage evidence says a free or cheaper alternative is sufficient
allocation: Use existing 561 Group research, web, measurement, payment, and agent capacity to build one end-to-end mock-client service loop; external cash risk is zero until the Leader launch gate; the existing USD 500 Stripe payment link remains disabled.
appraisal: Morgan Sennhauser completes at least one end-to-end mock-client traversal; every objection and failure becomes a retained product requirement; the service can produce an inspectable evidence bundle, a least-cost recommendation, a fulfillment record, and an acceptance/revision state; price, scope, and labor are measured rather than assumed.
